cards.lore: Calcium or Bone is a Heavy Hitter that blocks the beam, creating the shadow-silhouette.
cards.power: The Density-Mapper. Ray shoots through the body; bones stop him (White), air lets him fly (black); everything else is grey.

cards.lore: X-Ray Attenuation calculates precise density. Distinguishes Fresh-Blood (+80 HU) from Simple-Fluid (0 HU).
cards.power: The Slice-and-Dice. Hunter spins, creating 3D volumes that can be sliced in any direction.

cards.lore: Based on Acoustic Impedance. Watches the Heart Pump in real-time without hurting it.
cards.power: The Bounce-Back. Fluid is Black (Silent), Bone is White-Noisy (Hyperechoic).

cards.lore: Unlocks Soft-Tissue Secrets. Sees the nerves and ligaments that Roentgen-Ray completely misses.
cards.power: The Proton-Spinner. Mag makes the body's Water-Protons dance to his magnetic rhythm.

cards.lore: You only see a border when Air meets Water. If Water meets Water, the line is erased.
cards.power: The Boundary-Blur. Tells you exactly which Lobe-Lobby is full of fluid.

cards.lore: Thickened interlobular septa. The first sign the lungs are becoming a Swamp.
cards.power: The Fluid-Ladder. When the Heart-Pump fails, Lymphatic-Drains overflow, drawing rungs on the ladder.

cards.lore: Ischemic necrosis of parenchyma. Revealed by a Filling Defect in the pipe on CT-Angio.
cards.power: The Dead-Zone. The PE-Phantom blocks an artery; a wedge of tissue dies and turns white.

cards.lore: Proof that Alveolar-Balloons are full of pus, but Airway-Tunnels remain open.
cards.power: The Tubule-Glow. Shows the Air-Pipes running through a solid Infection-Block.

cards.lore: Normally you only see the inside. If you see the outside too, there is Free-Air-Frenzy.
cards.power: The Leak-Detector. Appears when a pipe pops, letting air escape into the belly.

cards.lore: A closed-loop surgical emergency. If not untwisted, it becomes Necrosis-Nick.
cards.power: The Twist-Indicator. Shows exactly where the colon has a Twisted-Spaghetti Obstruction.

cards.lore: Localized paralysis of the gut caused by nearby Cytokine-Chaos.
cards.power: The Crime-Scene-Pointer. Stays perfectly still and bloated, pointing at the Inflammation-Riot.

cards.lore: Transmural scarring and spasm. If the thread completely breaks, a Fistula forms.
cards.power: The Stricture-Signal. Shows where chronic inflammation turns the Gut-Highway into a Narrow-Thread.

cards.lore: The skull is a Fixed-Box. If Mitch pushes too hard, he causes Herniation-Harry — the total system crash.
cards.power: The Brain-Bully. Occurs when a Brain-Bleed pushes the whole brain-center to one side.

cards.lore: Tearing of Bridging-Veins. Common in Elderly-Wrestling after a minor Tumble.
cards.power: The Slow-Squeeze. A Venous-Leak that slowly wraps around the brain like a creeping shadow.

cards.lore: Tearing of Middle Meningeal-Artery. Features a Lucid-Interval before total blackout.
cards.power: The High-Pressure-Punch. An Arterial-Burst building fast, punching a sharp lens-shape.

cards.lore: Essential for spotting MS-the-Plaque-Maker or Stroke-Steve.
cards.power: The Edema-Finder. Turns off the White-Noise of normal CSF so only Inflammation-Fluid glows.

cards.lore: Garry makes things Bright-White on T1. If it glows, it's growing or it's angry.
cards.power: The Barrier-Breaker. Only shows up where the Blood-Brain-Barrier is broken by Tumor-Max.

cards.lore: Finds Hank-the-Hemorrhage or Clot-the-Blocker. Caveat: Watch out for the kidneys!
cards.power: The Vessel-Painter. Iodine turns blood into White-Flowing-Lava on a CT scan.

cards.lore: High density allows for Double-Contrast (Air + Barium) to see incredibly fine surface detail.
cards.power: The Gut-Coater. Barium paints the Digestive-Tunnel lining, revealing Percy-the-Ulcer.

cards.lore: Prevented by Fluid-Flooding before the scan. High-risk for Diabetes-Dan.
cards.power: The Kidney-Stunner. Nephro strikes when Iodine-the-Ion is too harsh on the Renal-Tubes.

cards.lore: Common in Gymnast-and-Wrestler athletes who ask their backs too much.
cards.power: The Spine-Snap. Shows a stress-fracture in the Pars-Interarticularis.

cards.lore: Blood filling the joint capsule physically pushes the normal fat pads out of their hiding spots.
cards.power: The Hidden-Blood-Detector. Shows the Shadow-of-Blood even if the fracture is invisible.

cards.lore: A stark indicator of Ligament-Laceration or unstable, sliding fractures.
cards.power: The Staircase-Sign. Shows exactly where a joint has Slipped-the-Gears.

cards.lore: The bone tries to build new periosteum armor but fails, leaving radiating Sunray-Spikes.
cards.power: The Bone-Explosion. Malignant-Max Tumor grows so fast it blasts through the bone-armor.

cards.lore: Sound is reflected 100% by the surface, leaving the area behind it absolutely Silent-and-Black.
cards.power: The Gallstone-Guard. Cathy-the-Gallstone is so hard that zero sound waves can pass through.

cards.lore: Sound bounces back and forth infinitely inside the metal, confusing the machine into seeing a long Tail.
cards.power: The Metal-Finder. Appears when sound hits a rigid Needle or a Stent.

cards.lore: Remember BART: Blue Away, Red Toward. Essential for tracking down Doris-the-DVT.
cards.power: The Flow-Meter. Shows if blood is blasting Toward (Red) or away (Blue) from the Pipe-Highway or stalled by a clot.

cards.lore: Micro-crystals and heavy mucus settling quietly at the absolute bottom of the Biliary-Bucket.
cards.power: The Stagnant-Pool. Sludge is the Pre-Stone-Thickening of bile that slowly shifts with gravity.

cards.lore: Excellent for sniffing out Mitch-the-Metastasis long before he shows up on a standard Roentgen-Ray.
cards.power: The Repair-Radar. Glows bright wherever Bone-Builders are working overtime to fix damage.

cards.lore: Hot-Nodes are overactive but benign. Cold-Nodes are silent, sneaky, and potentially lethal.
cards.power: The Cancer-Crate. A Cold-Node isn't making hormone. In ENT, this is highly suspicious.

cards.lore: Cancer cells are Anabolic Gluttons (Warburg Effect), turning them into glaring Neon-Signs.
cards.power: The Hunger-Detector. Shows which cells are Eating-Sugar the fastest. Tumor-Max is always hungry.

cards.lore: The classic scintigraphic signature of a massive Pulmonary Embolism.
cards.power: The Clot-Hunter. Finds the area of lung that is Breathing fine but has No-Blood-Flow.

cards.lore: The foundation of IR. Once the Guidewire-Ghost is placed, the Catheter-Cavalry can safely follow.
cards.power: The Wire-Master. Seldinger lets the surgeon enter any Pipe in the body through a tiny pinhole.

cards.lore: Creates a perfectly timed Strategic-Clot exactly where the plumbing is failing most.
cards.power: The Bleed-Stopper. Intentionally blocks a Leaky-Pipe to stop a hemorrhage or starve a tumor.

cards.lore: Installs permanent, unyielding structural support for a failing, narrowed Vessel-Wall.
cards.power: The Pipe-Prop. Pushes Athero-Al's gunk tightly against the wall to keep the Highway open.

cards.lore: Relies on Gravity-and-Negative-Pressure to entirely drain the deeply buried Septic-Swamp.
cards.power: The Pus-Vacuum. Bypasses the Blade-Brigade to safely suck infection through a tiny tube.

cards.lore: A positive FAST-Fiona means the wrestler is actively bleeding internally — straight to the OR!
cards.power: The Blood-Seeker. Scans the belly and heart-sac in seconds to hunt for hidden hemorrhage.

cards.lore: Primarily a clinical diagnosis, but Roentgen-Ray confirms it visually with a massive Vivid-Air-Space.
cards.power: The Heart-Crusher. A one-way air valve inflates until it squeezes the heart from pumping.

cards.lore: A subtle but increasingly important sign of a massive Pneumothorax in the supine ICU patient.
cards.power: The Hidden-Air-Detector. When a wrestler is lying flat, Tension-Tony's air hides at the bottom.

cards.lore: High pressure violently rips the layers apart. If the tear hits the Heart-Gate, it's game over.
cards.power: The Double-Pipe. Shows the Wall-Tear that splits the main aorta into two competing tunnels.

cards.lore: A score of 4 or 5 is a massive red flag meaning Biopsy-for-the-Win.
cards.power: The Risk-Meter. Tells the surgeon exactly how worried they need to be about a Lump-Max.

cards.lore: Desmoplastic reaction physically shortens and pulls on the surrounding Cooper's-Ligaments.
cards.power: The Malignant-Signature. The distinct radiographic look of cancer Reaching-Out to invade.

cards.lore: Microscopic apoptotic debris inside the breast ducts that has died and turned to stone.
cards.power: The DCIS-Signal. Tiny, jagged white dots that look like Cracked-Salt, often the only early sign.

cards.lore: Malignant tissue is Dense-and-Absorbing, while benign simple cysts are Fluid-and-Transmitting.
cards.power: The Solid-Finder. If the sound waves can't pierce through the lump, it's highly suspicious.

cards.lore: Dictates Time, Distance, and Shielding. Use Echo or Mag whenever possible instead.
cards.power: The Radiation-Shield. Ensures we use the absolute minimum Roentgen-Rays needed to win.

cards.lore: The incredibly high atomic number of lead absorbs the incoming X-ray energy before it hits DNA.
cards.power: The Photon-Stop. Lead armor stops stray Roentgen-Rays from hitting the Ovarian-Bench.

cards.lore: Ionizing radiation is infinitely more dangerous during the delicate Organ-Creation phase.
cards.power: The Fetal-Defense. The supreme rule: always ask if there is a Fetal-Fighter in the fortress.

cards.lore: The magnet is ALWAYS ON; it will rip ferromagnetic metal through the air like a fired rocket.
cards.power: The Magnetic-Attraction. Mag-the-Magnet turns wheelchairs and pacemakers into Lethal-Projectiles.

cards.lore: Comparison is the key to Radiology. A terrifying lump from 2020 is much safer if it hasn't grown.
cards.power: The Infinite-Memory. PACS stores every scan the wrestler has ever had for Old-vs-New battles.

cards.lore: The classic, definitive hallmark of advanced colon cancer visualized on a Barium-Enema.
cards.power: The Cancer-Collar. Shows precisely where Malignant-Max has wrapped entirely around the colon.

cards.lore: The irreversible signature of Pulmonary Fibrosis. The lungs are now permanent, unyielding stone.
cards.power: The End-Stage-Lung. Chronic inflammation turns the flexible breathing-balloons into useless cysts.

cards.lore: The delicate epiglottis leaf swells up so large it looks exactly like a giant thumb on the X-ray.
cards.power: The Airway-Alarm. A massive warning that the wrestler's primary breathing tube is swelling shut.

cards.lore: Don't just look, see! Is the silhouette lost? Is the HU correct? Compare it to the old films or stay in the dark! Stay Fluffy!
cards.power: The Pattern-Recognizer. Doc: 'Don't just look, see! Is the silhouette lost? Is the HU correct? Compare it to the old films or stay in the dark! Stay fluffy!'

cards.lore: Trauma wrestler. Sharp pain, low SpO2. Supine chest X-ray shows Deep-Sulcus-Sign.
A CT head scan shows Crescent-Chris on the left side and Lemon-Lenny on the right.
A PET scan shows the Malignant-Max and Metastasis-Mitch, and explain exactly why their cells glow so bright on the scan.
